text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The group was in Tomakomai. Smart Falcon 
asks Hokko Tarumae to show her around 
places filled with Tarumae's memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After visiting places full of memories 
like the park and shopping street, Smart 
Falcon is delighted to have gotten to know 
Hokko Tarumae's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer also tells Hokko Tarumae that 
Tomakomai is her hometown—and that they 
love it too, feeling like it's their own 
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touching upon her feelings helped her see 
it that way. However, she had only ever 
shared facts about Tomakomai with her 
fans, never speaking of her deep love for 
her hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae realized the truth as well. 
—And so, she sprang into action to share 
her heartfelt feelings for her hometown at 
the Fan Appreciation Festival!
